notes.title: Latest Retro Army game now on Greenlight!
notes.content:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=744648981

Death's Hangover is a ball and bat game, featuring mature comedy and themes. (Mainly poop jokes)

'Old grim has a hangover, and a really bad one.. after discovering b*****d dracula has stolen souls, he summons two of the greatest dead warriors to have ever lived, or the first ones he could find... 

Only these two dead morons can get the souls back and defeat b******d Dracula once and for all. If they fail, Death will kill them again... So no pressure..'  

Game features 

- A Ball, 
- A Bat, 
- Two dead idiots, 
- 96+ levels, 
- Massive boss fights, 
- Unique Bonus stages, 
- Sticky, Spike and ghost power-ups, plus many more, 
- Powerups can be leveled up, 
- Control the speed of the ball, with dash, and slowdown, 
- Puzzle levels, as well as arcade style levels, 
- Multiple routes, and secret areas, 
- Wacky humor throughout, 

'The game is about 40% finished and we're looking to release within two months' - Dev 

Happy voting, don't forget to vote now! or old grim will be very unhappy or just hungover.. He's a very grouchy dude.

notes.title: Play our 'Verdict Guilty' 90's fighter! Now on Steam Early access!
notes.content:
http://www.verdictguilty.com/logo.png

Verdict Guilty is an exciting new fighting game featuring hand and gun combat set in the dangerous city of Neo Seoul. 

Neo Seoul has been hit with a wave of terrorist and crime attacks, only a few good officers remain willing to battle this new evil. Discover the dark secrets of Neo Seoul as you fight your way to uncover the truth. Choose your side cop or criminal, as you battle your way to unmask the evil syndicate crimelord himself. 

http://www.verdictguilty.com/bar.png

Game Features: 

- Eight unique fighters to choose from, 
- Choose to fight on the police side or as a criminal, 
- Story mode, unique for each character, 
- Easy to perform special moves, 
- 60FPs lightning fast gameplay, 
- Unique gun combat, employ machineguns, pistols and grenades, 
- Fully animated and detailed backgrounds, 
- Awesome music by Bossfights, 
- 16:10 and 16:9 widescreen support, 
- Dual controller support, 
- Steam leaderboards, trading cards and achievements, 
- Small download, works on netbooks and old pc's also, 
- Epic value, 

Verdict Guilty is currently still in development and is 90% finished to a polished standard, all backgrounds, characters and moves are done. We are looking to do a full release on 14th April, 2016. 

Link below->

Verdict Guilty is part of our new 'Epic value' range which retail at the competitive price of just $2.99!

Thanks for taking a look at our product! Any questions please leave a comment below. 

Paul Stephen-Davis 
@Bluestargeneral 
Ceo Retro Army Ltd 

http://www.verdictguilty.com/chars.png

notes.title: Sequel needs your vote on steam greenlight!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Just an update on the sequel, we added Super trench attack 2 to steam greenlight yesterday. Please leave us a vote if it's something you'd like to see on steam.

Vote here

We've been working hard on the sequel and are looking for a late july release depending on how long the greenlight process will take. The game is about 70% finished. 

Super Trench Attack 2 is a turn-based squad game set in a fictional world war setting. 

You are Ada Frost, a lieutenant of the blue army. You find yourself deep behind enemy lines, with the stolen black army plans in your hands, you can end the war. That is, if you and your squad can make it back home alive! 

Of course the Black army won't let you escape that easily, They have dispatched their top general the evil Helmut, to stop you in your tracks. Fight through the desert sands, traverse the icy peaks, and battle through the muddy trenches, get those plans to H.Q before the evil general catches you! 

Game Features 
- Procedurally generated levels, and missions 
- Over 2000 random events, no play through is the same 
- Play blackjack and hunt for food 
- Four different C.O's to choose from 
- Recruit four different character classes to your squad 
- Upgrade your troops with the flexible 'weapon pack' system 
- Goofball humor throughout 
- Enemy commanders have different tactics and A.I 
- Fight through snow, deserts, beaches, cities and forests 


Thank you for your time!

Paul Stephen-Davis
@bluetstargeneral
CEO Retro Army Ltd

notes.title: Sequel coming soon!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that Super Trench Attack 2 is in development and we're looking for a late July release, 2015. 

We've listened carefully to player feedback and have been working hard to implement new features and design changes to the sequel. We wouldn't be able to make this game without your support, so we'd like to thank everyone who has voted, left feedback and just generally been a great fanbase to work with!

Super Trench Attack 2 is a turn-based squad game set in a world war setting

As a commander of the Blue Army you find yourself deep behind enemy lines. With the stolen black army plans in your hands, you can end this war... If you can keep your squad alive and make it back to H.Q that is.

Unfortunately everyone and their dog wants your team dead, death lurks behind every corner. If you can survive the freezing icy peaks, and cross the blazing desert dunes, you might stand a chance. Fellow soldiers will join you along the way, but the odds are against you and time is running out, will your team be able to survive the grueling journey and outrun the enemy?

Game Features

Strategic turn-based squad combat,
Tense and fast survival gameplay, with permadeath,
Procedurally generated levels, maps and missions,
Over 2000 random events, no play through is the same,
Play blackjack and hunt for food,
Recruit up to 20 units and six different character classes to your squad,
Goofball humor throughout,
Enemy commanders have different tactics and A.I,
Fight through snow, deserts, beaches, cities, farms and forests,




You can keep up to date with the games progress, on our twitter feed
here!

notes.title: Save 66% on Super Trench Attack!
notes.content:
Save 66% on Super Trench Attack as part of this weeklong Deal*!

Super Trench Attack™ is a goofball comedy twitch-shooter based in a World War setting.

STORYLINE 
The Dastardly Black Army has invaded your beloved homeland! The only thing between them and victory stands one man. A crazy recruit with an eye for headshots and a boot for kicking the enemy up the....well you get the picture. Enter the crazy world of Super Trench Attack. 

GAME FEATURES 

Unique targeting system, there's even footshots! 
Smooth as glass 60FPS shooting action, 
Full Xbox® 360 Controller support, for 'blasting action', 
4 huge open areas to explore, with many secret areas, 
16 varied missions, including giant bosses and shooting galleries, 
Crazy Buddy AI character to watch your back, 
4 shops offering unique items, weapons and traps, for a variety of ways to   play, 
33+ Resolutions, including 8:5 and 16:9 widescreen, 
Qwerty, Azerty and left hand controls, 
Goofball bonkers humor.


*Offer ends Monday the 12th of January at 10AM Pacific Time.

notes.title: Version 3.5! Is now available!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the new version 3.5 is available and will be downloaded automatically for you by steam.

New Features

(Player Request)
Pressing F2 will now switch between 360 controller or mouse/keyboard,
Make clothes after beating game work better, and increase more,
Change face for hard mode, at difficulty select screen,
Make grenades limited,
Leave buddy on after beating game,

(My Changes)
Added you can throw grenades whilst swimming sign to pebble beach,
Made pebble bay tunnel easier to find,
Made healthkits cheaper,
Added footshot manual to second mission,

(Bugs) 
Title screen was offset due to slow load-up time,
Train bug scrolls past forever,
Check L/R speakers aren't swapped,
Issues with certain machines not loading the game,
Black mole now wins when it's reaches the end of the level,
Bug where after beating black mole retry sign goes back to the black mole when on new mission,
Player says nothing when entering windmill on act3,

Any problems let me know!

Paul Stephen-Davis
twitter@BlueStarGeneral
email : paul@retroarmy.com

notes.title: Xbox® 360 Controller support & DirectX now available!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce a new version of STA is ready for you to devour...I mean enjoy!

Super trench attack! now features full Xbox® 360 controller support! We've also added directX rendering as default, as well as implemented all player requests received. 

Version 3.4 features

    Full Xbox® 360 controller support for 'blasting action',
    Both DirectX and OpenGL rendering,
    Launch arguments,
    All areas are available after beating the game,
    Azerty keyboard support,
    Shooting galleries are alot easier,
    Increased rifle fire-rate,
    Added Bob & Andy to Summer camp,
    Added more death sound variations,
    Fixed cellar achievement bug,
